Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
Abstract
Neural machine translation models typically operate with a fixed vocabulary, but translation is an open-vocabulary problem. We encode rare and unknown words as sequences of subword units, which lets the model translate words it has never seen.

title: SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer

SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer
Abstract
SentencePiece is a language independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer. It trains subword models directly from raw sentences and treats the whitespace as a normal symbol, so no language specific pre-tokenization is required.

title: SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer
text: SentencePiece is a language-independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer for neural text processing. It trains subword models from raw sentences and treats whitespace as an ordinary symbol.
embed_text:
SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer
Abstract
SentencePiece is a language-independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer for neural text processing. It trains subword models from raw sentences and treats whitespace as an ordinary symbol.

title: ByT5: Towards a token-free future with pre-trained byte-to-byte models

ByT5: Towards a token-free future with pre-trained byte-to-byte models
Abstract
Byte-level models operate directly on raw UTF-8 bytes, so they need no vocabulary and no tokenizer, handle any language out of the box, and are robust to spelling noise.
